name: Cribbage
summary: Two-player card game where players peg points to 121 through play and hand combinations using a crib and starter card.
rules_text: Played with 52 cards. Each hand, 6 cards dealt to each player. Each discards 2 face-down to form the dealer's crib. Non-dealer cuts deck, dealer reveals starter; Jack as starter scores 2 for dealer. Play phase: alternate playing one card counting running total to ≤31. No points can exceed 31. If unable to play, say Go, opponent scores 1; hitting exactly 31 scores 2; total resets after 31 or Go. During play score 2 for making 15, 2 for pair, 6 for three of a kind, 12 for four, 3-5 for runs of 3-5. After play, score hands: non-dealer, then dealer, then crib. Each hand is 4 cards plus starter. Score 2 per 15, 2 per pair, 1 per card in runs, 4 for 4-flush in hand, 5 if flush includes starter or in crib, 1 for Jack matching starter suit (nobs). First to 121 wins immediately.
rating_reason: Classic 2-player card game, hidden hands, turn-based, arithmetic scoring, fully expressible.
